steps.name: Virtual Private Server
procedure_descriptions: [FLORAHOX Activity](https://attack.mitre.org/campaigns/C0053) has used acquired Virtual Private Servers as control systems for the ORB network.(Citation: ORB Mandiant)

steps.name: Network Devices
procedure_descriptions: [FLORAHOX Activity](https://attack.mitre.org/campaigns/C0053) has compromised network routers and IoT devices for the ORB network.(Citation: ORB Mandiant)

steps.name: Exploit Public-Facing Application
procedure_descriptions: [FLORAHOX Activity](https://attack.mitre.org/campaigns/C0053) has exploited and infected vulnerable routers to recruit additional network devices into the ORB.(Citation: ORB Mandiant)

steps.name: Command and Scripting Interpreter
procedure_descriptions: [FLORAHOX Activity](https://attack.mitre.org/campaigns/C0053) has executed PHP and Shell scripts to identify and infect subsequent routers for the ORB network.(Citation: ORB Mandiant)

steps.name: Unix Shell
procedure_descriptions: [FLORAHOX Activity](https://attack.mitre.org/campaigns/C0053) has executed multiple Bash controller scripts to provide command line inputs for FLORAHOX traversal configurations.(Citation: ORB Mandiant)

steps.name: Multi-hop Proxy
procedure_descriptions: [FLORAHOX Activity](https://attack.mitre.org/campaigns/C0053) has routed traffic through a customized [Tor](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S0183) relay network layer.(Citation: ORB Mandiant)
